description: Cross-platform game achievements: one definition list mirrored to Google Play Games, Game Center and Steam with an idempotent earned-minus-acknowledged sync, structural adapters, and store-console submission files.
rules: Pass the game-services plugin and the steamworks.js client in; the package never imports them.
Never queue reports: what a platform needs is always earned minus acknowledged.
Record an acknowledgement only after the platform confirmed it, and never lower one.
Describe a graded achievement as one achievement per grade; the platforms have no tiers.
